_status: draft - English only, ready for voice cloning
_readme: All spoken lines for airplane-v2.html. Edit 'lines' (the templates). Then run `node tools/build_airplane_v2.mjs` - it regenerates 'renders' (every final sentence with its target audio file) and re-embeds this file into airplane-v2.html. Any render whose audio file exists is played; otherwise the game falls back to the browser's text-to-speech using the same text.
_how_to_record: Clone each voice in 'voices', then render every entry in 'renders' to its 'file' path (mp3 or wav - keep the extension in the path in sync). 'common' files are shared by all airlines; files under an airline id folder (cx, jl, ...) contain that airline's name, callsign or flight number. ATC lines marked prefix/suffix 'callsign' are played as two clips back to back: the airline's callsign clip, then the generic instruction.

captain.description: The player's captain. Warm, calm, friendly PA voice.

first_officer.description: Co-pilot in the right seat. Short crisp cockpit callouts.

purser.description: Lead flight attendant. Bright, polite cabin PA voice.

ramp.description: Ground crew on the pushback headset. Casual, slightly radio-filtered.

ground.description: Airport ground controller (taxi). Fast radio voice.

tower.description: Airport tower controller. Fast radio voice.

center.description: En-route (cruise) air traffic controller for the Sky Challenge. Calm radio voice.

tcas.description: The airplane's automatic collision-avoidance voice. Flat, synthetic, urgent.

variables.flight_spoken: Flight number read digit by digit, e.g. 'four five one'
variables.runway_spoken: Runway read out, e.g. 'two five left'
variables.fl_spoken: Flight level read digit by digit, e.g. 'three seven zero'

pa_chime.description: Two-tone 'bing-bong' before a cabin PA announcement.
pa_chime.search: airplane chime, PA chime, cabin chime

seatbelt_ding.description: Single soft ding when the seatbelt sign turns on or off.

call_bell.description: Flight attendant call button high ding (used for success).

engine_start.search: jet engine start, turbine spool up

engine_loop.description: Seamless jet engine roar loop. Volume follows thrust.
engine_loop.search: jet engine loop, airplane interior loop

cabin_ambience.description: Quiet cruise cabin hum loop (cabin, window and cockpit views).

gear_motion.description: Hydraulic whine + clunk of landing gear moving.

gear_horn.description: Warning horn when gear can't move yet.

rotate_cue.description: Rising 3-note cue when it's time to rotate.

success_big.description: Bigger fanfare for milestones (doors sealed, airborne).

error.description: Gentle 'not yet' buzz for wrong button.

thunder.description: Distant thunder near storm clouds (Sky Challenge).

turbulence.description: Rattling/buffeting loop while inside a storm.

master_caution.description: Cockpit caution chime (TCAS traffic / failed challenge).

lines.trigger: Plays when the game starts at the gate.
lines.text: Good day, and welcome aboard {airline}. Please find your seat and put your bags in the overhead bins.
Ladies and gentlemen, the cabin doors are now closed. Please make sure your seatbelt is fastened.
Cabin crew, arm doors and cross-check.

lines.trigger: Jet bridge pulled away, tug connected.
lines.text: Cockpit, ground. Tow bar connected. Ready for pushback when you are, Captain.

lines.trigger: First time the player holds PUSH BACK.
lines.text: Brakes released. Pushing back now.
Pushback complete. Set parking brake. Tow bar disconnected. Have a great flight!
Ladies and gentlemen, this is Captain {captain_name} speaking. Welcome aboard {airline} flight {flight_spoken}. We will be on our way shortly. Sit back and enjoy the flight.
{callsign} {flight_spoken}, taxi to runway {runway_spoken} via Alpha.
Please make sure your seatbelt is fastened, your seat back is upright, and your tray table is stowed. Thank you.

lines.trigger: Airplane lines up on the runway.
lines.text: {callsign} {flight_spoken}, runway {runway_spoken}, line up and wait.
Flaps ten. Green light.
Cabin crew, please be seated for takeoff.
{callsign} {flight_spoken}, wind calm, runway {runway_spoken}, cleared for takeoff.
Thrust set.
Eighty knots.
V one.

lines.trigger: Speed enters the green Vr zone.
lines.text: Rotate.
Positive rate.

lines.trigger: Player presses LDG GEAR in the air.
lines.text: Gear up.

lines.trigger: A few seconds after gear up.
lines.text: {callsign} {flight_spoken}, contact departure. Good day.

lines.trigger: Player presses FLAPS during the climb.
lines.text: Flaps up.
We have now reached our cruising altitude of thirty five thousand feet. The fasten seatbelt sign is now off. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the flight.

lines.trigger: After the cruise announcement, before the end screen.
lines.text: Ladies and gentlemen, our cabin crew will soon come through the cabin with drinks and snacks. Thank you for flying with us.

lines.trigger: Played before/after generic ATC clips that are marked prefix/suffix 'callsign'.
lines.text: {callsign} {flight_spoken},
Ladies and gentlemen, this is Captain {captain_name}. We are cruising at thirty five thousand feet. Please keep your seatbelt fastened while seated.

lines.trigger: Airplane flies into a storm cell.
lines.text: Turbulence! Let's get out of this storm.
clear of weather. Resume own navigation.
traffic, twelve o'clock, opposite direction, same altitude. Report in sight.
Looking for the traffic. Watch the radar screen.

lines.trigger: Traffic advisory (amber circle on the radar).
lines.text: Traffic, traffic.

lines.trigger: Resolution advisory: climb (red square on the radar).
lines.text: Climb, climb.
Descend, descend.
Clear of conflict.
traffic no longer a factor. Return to your assigned altitude.

lines.trigger: Player did not follow the TCAS command.
lines.text: That was too close! Let's try again.
No problem, Captain. Let's try that one again.
Great flying, Captain!
great flying today. Contact the next center. Good day.
